summary: Ternium S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its annual general meeting of shareholders approved all agenda items, including adoption of financial statements, a final dividend of $1.30 per ADS ($0.13 per share) payable May 15, 2026, re-election of eight directors, and reappointment of PwC as auditor. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine report of ordinary shareholder meeting results with no unusual or extraordinary items.
